tema: Articles — a / an / the · Ola B: El Café de las Runas

banco_oraciones.oracion: Ben orders a coffee and a croissant.
The café has an old piano in the corner.
Kenji sits at the table next to the window.
There is an umbrella under the chair.
The bill isn't on the table.
Ben doesn't have a book today.
Is there a café near the museum?
Do you have the bill, please?
Is the café open? Yes, it is.
Do you have a table for two? No, we don't.
Is this the right door? Yes, it is.

interaccion: Ben: I need **a** coffee. **A** big coffee. Today I am **an** exhausted photographer.
Kenji: Look, there is **an** old piano in **the** corner! And **a** cat under **the** table.
Sofía: **The** menu is on **the** wall. They have **an** excellent croissant.
Abuela Carmen: In **a** café, **the** first rule is: never rush **the** coffee.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: I need coffee, please. A table for one.
banner_diagnostico.opcion_b: I need a coffee, please. A table for one.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Articles present a noun: a/an for one thing among many (any table), the for the specific one everybody in the scene knows (the bill) — and English needs them even where Spanish doesn't.

tabla.titulo: a / an / the — en el café
filas: a coffee, a table, a menu
an umbrella, an old piano, an hour
the specific one in the scene
the bill, the window, the corner
English needs it: He is A waiter

ejercicios.pregunta: There is ___ old piano in the corner.
He is ___ waiter at the café.

ejercicios.afirmacion: We say 'an umbrella' because 'umbrella' starts with a vowel SOUND.
In English you can say 'He is waiter' without an article.

ejercicios.texto: Kenji sits at ___ table next to the window. (a / an / the)
There is ___ umbrella under the chair. (a / an / the)
The café has ___ cat. It sleeps under the piano. (a / an / the)
___ menu is on the wall. (a / an / the)

guion: Ben: Excuse me, is there a table near the window?
Sofía: Yes, the table in the corner is free.
Ben: Perfect. A coffee and a croissant, please.
Kenji: Look, Ben! There is a cat under your chair.
Ben: A cat? It is an elegant cat. It has a hat.
Sofía: That is the café cat. The hat is an accident.

reading.texto: Ben writes on his blog: 'There is a café near the museum, and it is my office now. The café has an old piano, a sleepy cat and the best croissant in the city. I sit at the same table every day — the table next to the window. Today a waiter dropped a cup, and the cat didn't move. It is a very calm cat. I ordered the bill an hour ago. I am still waiting. It is a slow café, but it is my café.'

preguntas.afirmacion: The café is near the museum.
The café has a new piano.
